mapper.update: UPDATE `employee` SET full_name = #{fullName}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, position = #{position}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, id_card = #{idCard}, marital_status = #{maritalStatus}, political_status = #{politicalStatus}, nationality = #{nationality}, ethnicity = #{ethnicity}, native_place = #{nativePlace}, hukou_location = #{hukouLocation}, current_address = #{currentAddress}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, health_status = #{healthStatus}, highest_education = #{highestEducation}, major = #{major}, professional_title = #{professionalTitle}, foreign_language = #{foreignLanguage}, hobbies = #{hobbies}, photo_path = #{photoPath}, wechat_account = #{wechatAccount}, form_status = #{formStatus}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE employee_uuid = #{employeeUuid}

UPDATE `employee` SET hr_confirmed_at = #{hrConfirmedAt}, hr_confirmed_by = #{hrConfirmedBy}, updated_at = #{hrConfirmedAt} WHERE employee_uuid = #{employeeUuid} AND employment_type = 'FULL_TIME' AND form_status = 'SUBMITTED' AND hr_confirmed_at IS NULL
mapper.sql:
WHERE hr_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
AND full_name LIKE CONCAT(#{request.fullName}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT(#{request.phone}, '%')
AND customer_name LIKE CONCAT(#{request.customerName}, '%')
AND position LIKE CONCAT(#{request.position}, '%')
AND employment_status = #{request.employmentStatus}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM `employee`
ORDER BY hired_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN employment_status = 'PROBATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS probation_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN employment_status != 'RESIGNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN employment_status != 'RESIGNED' AND work_location = 'HEADQUARTERS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS headquarters_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN employment_status != 'RESIGNED' AND work_location = 'DISPATCHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dispatched_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN employment_status = 'RESIGNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resigned_count FROM `employee` WHERE hr_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
